note: Tome Base is a dependency-only glue sub-module: shared services/traits (CommandBase, ProcessTrait, ExecutableFinderTrait, PathTrait) plus one Drush cli.workaround service. It has no config, routes, permissions, plugins, or admin UI, so there is no per-module setting to read or write. Easy cases test knowledge of its role. The medium case introspects that it is enabled and depended-on. The hard case exercises the layer it actually provides: every tome:* Drush command extends its CommandBase, so exporting an existing entity with tome:export-content proves the CommandBase/Process layer works. It uses existing node:1 (uuid 5528817f-2211-4569-91a2-af6f5da9da25); no fixtures are created and no page is rendered.

evals.prompt: In the Tome project, what is the tome_base sub-module for? Name the base class that Tome's Drush commands (like tome:static and tome:export) extend.
evals.expected_output: tome_base holds shared services and traits used by both Tome Static and Tome Sync. Every tome:* Drush command extends Drupal\tome_base\CommandBase, which provides --uri handling and the concurrent-process helpers (ProcessTrait, ExecutableFinderTrait, PathTrait).

evals.prompt: Does the tome_base module have a settings form, a configure route, or permissions of its own?
evals.expected_output: No. tome_base is a dependency-only module: no config object, no configure route, no permissions, no plugins, and no admin UI. It only provides shared code (and one Drush cli.workaround service).

evals.prompt: tome_base registers a single Drush command service called cli.workaround. What problem does it solve?
evals.expected_output: CliWorkaroundCommands hooks pre-command php:cli and re-registers Tome's Symfony console commands as AnnotatedCommands so that 'drush php' works even though Tome adds non-annotated console commands. It is an @internal workaround for a Drush bug.

evals.prompt: Inspect this running site: is tome_base enabled, and which other Tome sub-modules declare it as a dependency?
evals.expected_output: tome_base is enabled. tome_static and tome_sync both list tome:tome_base as a dependency in their info.yml (verifiable via 'drush pm:list' and the sub-modules' info files).

evals.prompt: Tome's Drush commands are all built on tome_base's CommandBase. Use one of those commands to export the content entity 'node 1' to Tome's on-disk JSON store, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Run 'drush tome:export-content node:1' (its command class extends Drupal\tome_base\CommandBase). Tome writes content/node.<uuid>.json (uuid 5528817f-2211-4569-91a2-af6f5da9da25) as valid JSON.
